column1: # Nazaryan-Petersen et al. 2018 (PLoS Genet 14:e1007780), S2 Table: junction type per breakpoint junction.
# S2 Table gives both sides (GRCh37) and, for split-read junctions, a +/- per side. Equal signs = a direct
# (non-inverting) join, opposite signs = an inverting join; whether a direct join is deletion-like or
# duplication-like, and which inverting joins are head-to-head (+,+) or tail-to-tail (-,-), is curated here
# from the Table 1 HGVS description and the CMA copy-number segments of the same case.
# side1/side2 use the CxSV convention (workflow/lib/cxsv_scoring.record_orientation): '+' = the sequence
# ENDING at the breakpoint is retained, '-' = the sequence STARTING at it. DEL-like (+,-), DUP-like (-,+),
# inversion-type (+,+)/(-,-). basis: hgvs = derived from the Table 1 derivative; cn = direct join typed by
# the CMA segments flanking it; sign = inverting join from the S2 signs, head/tail assigned by alternation
# (not resolvable from the tables; affects only the fold-back/join-balance features).
